How ServiceNow AI Agents workRolesAn AI agent’s role defines its purpose, objectives, behavior, and interaction with users. In the ServiceNow AI Platform, roles are set in natural language rather than code.ToolsThey are the technologies and resources that AI agents use to perform tasks and achieve use cases. AI agents use tools like flow actions, subflows, scripts, and skills to execute tasks and fulfill their roles.Action FabricEmbedded within Action Fabric, the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol enables communication among ServiceNow and third-party AI agents. ServiceNow AI Agents can reach out to external tools, data, and systems via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) client.Agentic workflowsAgentic workflows represent the overall business objective you’re trying to achieve. Think of them as the reason why you’re deploying a team of AI agents. For example, you might want your AI agents to triage cases or categorize incidents.AI Agent OrchestratorThe AI Agent Orchestrator coordinates collaboration among teams of AI agents to successfully achieve specific goals. AI agent teams deliver better results than single AI agents, handling simple to complex workflows.AI Agent StudioA development tool within the ServiceNow AI Platform, AI Agent Studio lets you build and customize AI agents. You can easily create specialized AI agents, set guardrails, and automate tasks using a natural language interface.

Frequently asked questionsExpand All
What is an AI agent?

An AI agent can make decisions, take actions, and interact with their environment without continuous human intervention. They adapt to new information, learn over time, and manage a wide range of tasks that go beyond traditional automation. 

ServiceNow AI Agents, powered by the ServiceNow AI Platform, automate workflows, streamline operations, and adapt to diverse business needs across IT, HR, CRM, and more. They work together as teams guided by the AI Agent Orchestrator, accelerating outcomes and empowering people with a limitless, skilled digital workforce.

How do AI agents work? 
AI agents begin by defining goals and planning tasks within an agentic workflow, which represents the overall business problem they’re meant to solve. Then they gather relevant data from various sources and use it to reason and make decisions. Once they have a plan, AI agents use tools such as scripts, flows, and generative AI skills to execute tasks. AI agents monitor results, incorporate feedback, and adapt their approach. This continuous learning and improvement allows AI agents to refine their performance over time and handle complex tasks more effectively.
Can ServiceNow AI Agents support voice interactions?
Yes. ServiceNow offers AI voice agents out of the box, plus the ability to build and customize your own. They resolve employee and customer requests by phone, mobile, or web, in multiple languages. They cover common tasks like incident creation and status checks for IT; PTO and case management for HR; and order operations for customer service.
How are AI agents built? 

Building AI agents involves these key steps:

Define the AI agent's role, goals, and success metrics.  
Select a large language model (LLM) and an orchestration framework to manage its logic and workflows.  
Equip your agent with tools by integrating APIs for actions and knowledge bases. With ServiceNow Action Fabric, you can also use Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect your agent to external tools and resources. Additionally, retrieval augmented generation (RAG) can help you create contextual understanding.
Test the AI agent rigorously for safety and reliability. Then deploy your agent.
Monitor its performance, gather feedback, and continuously iterate to enhance the agent’s skills and business impact.  

This structured approach will help you develop effective AI agents.

How can I get ServiceNow AI Agents?
ServiceNow AI Agents are embedded in the ServiceNow AI Platform so they are business-ready from day one. AI agents collaborate across every department, making use of your existing workflows and data to solve complex business problems. You can build custom AI agents using natural language in AI Agent Studio or deploy thousands of prebuilt AI agents, all secured and governed by ServiceNow Super Intelligence Control Tower.
